classification: Skin-side empty-target, invocation-state and hidden-focus defects; not a removed Kodi API
source_findings: RunScript explicitly accepts the lyrics extension point; its non-script fallback deprecation does not apply to a selected lyrics addon.
RunScript requires one parameter; an empty resolved addon setting produces an invalid call.
Skin.SetAddon saves the selected ID only on confirmation. Cancel does not populate an empty setting.
CGUIAction selects all matching actions before executing the chain, so later conditions do not re-evaluate a completed addon selection.
StopScript accepts an addon ID and resolves its library path. Its FIXME about multiple extension points is not an announced removal or current API deprecation.
changes: MusicOSD 701: empty setting only opens the addon selector; configured setting retains Close and RunScript.
PlayerControls 609: remove Close and RunScript from the empty-selection altclick chain.
MusicOSD 2401/2402: disable start/stop controls when no lyrics addon is selected.
MusicOSD 701 and PlayerControls 609 explicitly enable Lyrics before RunScript; otherwise the skin lyrics window immediately executes Back.
Remove hidden-entry focus redirection to control 101; the provider assigns focus to list 110 when ready.
interaction_change: First choose the lyrics addon; a subsequent click starts it. Cancelling selection leaves the UI open and does not run an empty script target.
